claims: Coachella 2026 tickets are officially sold out.
Coachella 2026 tickets went on sale in September 2025.
Coachella 2026 tickets are currently only available via official resale on AXS or secondary markets like SeatGeek and StubHub.
Initial GA prices for Coachella 2026 were ~$549–$649.
Initial VIP prices for Coachella 2026 were ~$1,199–$1,299.
Resale market prices for Coachella 2026 have exceeded $2,000–$7,000 for last-minute passes.
Coachella 2026 is headlined by Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma.
The official waitlist for Coachella 2026 is closed.
Domestic orders for Coachella 2026 Weekend 1 after March 27 require pick-up at Will Call.
Domestic orders for Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 after April 3 require pick-up at Will Call.
